name: HyperINR
definition: A method predicting INR weights from scene parameters via a hypernetwork, using an ensemble of multi-resolution hash encoders organized in a KD-tree over the parameter space.
summary: HyperINR is a hypernetwork that predicts compact INR weights for interactive volumetric path tracing, achieving 100x faster inference than standard methods by interpolating encoding weights via multi-resolution hash encoders.
